import pytest
from subject import verify_companion_attestation, HandlerOccCompanionAttestation
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.models.model_occ_companion_request import ModelOccCompanionRequest
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.models.model_occ_companion_plan import ModelCompanionFile
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.models.model_occ_attestation_result import ModelOccAttestationRequest
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.handlers.handler_occ_companion_compute import compute_companion_plan


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_accepts_reproducible_files():
    """Test that verify_companion_attestation accepts files that match the recomputed plan."""
    request = ModelOccCompanionRequest(
        repo="test-repo",
        pr_number=123,
        contract_hash="abc123",
        receipt_hash="def456",
        runner="test-runner",
        verifier="test-verifier"
    )
    
    # Get the canonical plan and its files
    plan = compute_companion_plan(request)
    observed_files = plan.companion_files
    
    result = verify_companion_attestation(observed_files, request)
    
    assert result.accepted is True
    assert result.observed_digest == result.expected_digest
    assert "ACCEPTED" in result.reason
    assert "test-repo#123" in result.reason


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_rejects_tampered_files():
    """Test that verify_companion_attestation rejects tampered files."""
    request = ModelOccCompanionRequest(
        repo="test-repo",
        pr_number=123,
        contract_hash="abc123",
        receipt_hash="def456",
        runner="test-runner",
        verifier="test-verifier"
    )
    
    # Get the canonical plan and its files
    plan = compute_companion_plan(request)
    observed_files = list(plan.companion_files)
    
    # Tamper with one of the files
    if observed_files:
        tampered_file = observed_files[0].model_copy()
        tampered_file.content = b"tampered content"
        observed_files[0] = tampered_file
    
    result = verify_companion_attestation(tuple(observed_files), request)
    
    assert result.accepted is False
    assert result.observed_digest != result.expected_digest
    assert "REJECTED" in result.reason
    assert "test-repo#123" in result.reason
